title: docs(adr): ADR-0150 addendum: a hot upgrade over a still-served version carries at once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5wpk1gsxYNKAkG5qioWPNY)_

Fixes #33301

A two-sentence correction to the ADR-0150 D7 addendum that PR #33568 landed. While #33568 sat in the merge queue, PR #33473 (and #33050, PR #33304, before it) made a hot upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves carry its holders at once: the re-register withdraws the position the new version no longer ships, so the old name is no current position when the announcement is heard. #33568's text still listed that case under the next restart. `docs/adr/**` only (Tier H): it waits for a GOVERNED_APPROVER.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：只改 ADR-0150 第 288 行补遗里的一句：热升级（即使运行中的内核仍在提供旧版本）也会立即迁移持有人，移入“立即迁移”一栏；“下次重启才迁移”只剩“只报文件路径的产物重载”。
- **为什么改**：#33568 排队期间 #33473 合入（建立在 #33050 之上），热升级已在通告时立即迁移；#33568 的原句因而不实。
- **风险与回滚**：纯文档，无代码、无发布内容。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md` 第 288 行 “It runs at boot over every claim” 一句。
- **两分钟验证**：读该句，预期 “carried at the next restart” 之前只剩 “an artifact reload that names only its file”；与 `position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` “When it runs” 一节的热升级段一致。
- **需要你做的**：审阅并批准（Tier H，需 GOVERNED_APPROVER 批准后由席位落地）。

## What changes

`docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md` ~:288, one clause of the sentence "It runs at boot over every claim, …":

- FROM "a hot install-local install, the runtime `POST /packages` install, … are carried at once; a hot upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves and an artifact reload that names only its file are carried at the next restart."
- TO "a hot install-local install or upgrade, for the package the door announces (an upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves included, since the re-register withdraws the position the new version no longer ships), the runtime `POST /packages` install, … are carried at once; the other packages of a multi-package artifact, which install-local registers but does not name, and an artifact reload that names only its file are carried at the next restart."

Round 2 (contract review 6889382518): install-local announces only `app/` + its manifest id (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` :3817, :6805), so the other `packages[]` members of a multi-package artifact wait for the next boot; the code fix is #33656, which will drop the qualifier. Nit 2 folded in the refusals sentence: FROM "It does not carry an old name that is switched off." TO "It does not carry an old name that is switched off, nor carries holders onto a claimant whose package is disabled (refused `claimant-disabled` until an enable announces the package)."

No other sentence of the addendum and no ruling text changes.

## Tests

None: a docs-only diff.

## Acceptance notes

- Read against `origin/main` `babd5d4a`: `position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` "When it runs" says a hot upgrade over a still-served version is carried at once (#33050), pinned by PR #33473's real-kernel test through install-local. Whether an upgrade through the runtime `POST /packages` install also withdraws is not measured, so the text claims it for install-local only.
- PR #33546 (#33527) made the package disable and `DELETE` routes announce the withdrawal; the addendum says nothing about withdrawals, so nothing is claimed about them here.
- The refusals clause still reads true against `main`: the refusal set (`claimed-twice`, `claimant-disabled`, `still-declared`, `held-by-other`, `owned-by-other`, `switched-off`) is unchanged.
- `skip-changeset`: no published package ships `docs/adr`.

## Verification

At head `1bb25336` off `origin/main` `babd5d4a`: 21 derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`), all exit 0; `--ran`: "21 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 21 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Record: `pm-orders/spec/33301-pr3-r2-gates-ran.txt` in the project share.
